chunks: Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Mu'alla ibn 'Uthman, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

A free person is not killed in retaliation for a slave. So when a free person kills a slave, he is made liable for his price and is given a severe beating. And whoever is killed by legal retaliation or by the prescribed punishment, there is no blood-money for him.

key_terms.حُرٌّ: a free person, as opposed to a slave

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free person kills a slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation and financial liability in cases involving the killing of a slave by a free person. It also clarifies that one who is executed through qisas or hadd does not carry an entitlement to diyah.
